description: Converts an amount between two currencies using the official NBG rate in force on a calendar date. Either side may be GEL; a pair without GEL is converted through GEL (via: "GEL"). Show resultRounded as the amount; result is the unrounded value for further calculation. Dates are calendar days in Tbilisi; the default is today. NBG sets a rate on business days around 17:00 Tbilisi time, valid from the next calendar day until the next rate, so after 17:00 tomorrow can be requested by date. Sundays, Mondays and days after a public holiday have no rate of their own: the rate in force was set earlier and is returned with carriedOver true and effectiveDate set to the day it took effect. Quote effectiveDate when carriedOver is true. A date whose rate NBG has not published yet returns an error, never a guess.

amount.description: Amount in the "from" currency. May be negative.

date.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD whose official rate to apply. Defaults to today in Tbilisi.

name: nbg_convert

carriedOver.description: true when the rate in force on requestedDate took effect on an earlier day; it is still the official rate

effectiveDate.description: Calendar date the returned rate took effect, as published by NBG

resultRounded.description: result rounded half up to 2 decimals from the exact value; the amount to show. JSON drops trailing zeros, so 3.90 arrives as 3.9. Exact up to about 7e13 in the target currency; above that the nearest double.

title: Convert via NBG rate
